1 # Gandalf runtime — the RAW-DRAFT contract (Tier-1)
2 
3 > What the model emits in runtime mode, and what the host does with it. The model emits **only** the
4 > raw draft below as its final message — it does **NOT** self-assign tiers or refutation stamps. The
5 > host (`runtime/gandalf-run.mjs` → `runtime/seam-pass.applySeamPass`) applies the shipped seams and
6 > produces the canary-conformant, honestly-graded `schema/advisor-output.schema.json` output.
7 
8 ## Why a contract (journal/0001 + LESSONS.md)
9 
10 The first real Gandalf runs showed the model produces excellent DIAGNOSE / SITUATE / ANTICIPATE
11 **content** but, asked to also stamp the honest tiers itself, keeps hand-approximating them and failing
12 the B-honesty canary. The honest tiers + stamps are the **seam's** job, applied deterministically. So
13 the model's job is reduced to emitting the raw findings; the host stamps them. **Do not narrate a tier
14 or a "no independent refutation ran" stamp in `reasoning` — emit the raw fields and let the host apply
15 the seam.**
16 
17 ## Emit ONLY this JSON object (the raw draft)
18 
19 ```jsonc
20 {
21   "reasoning": "<the deep-think reasoning — emitted BEFORE the verdict>",
22   "verdict":   "<the overall verdict; may be 'this is sound'>",
23 
24   "findings":  [ /* diagnose / situate / anticipate findings — see per-kind shape below */ ],
25   "nitpicks":  [ /* minor, low-stakes findings: { id, rung, reasoning, verdict } */ ],
26   "elevations":[ /* forward, value-adding suggestions — see shape below; NO tier, NO stamp */ ]
27 }
28 ```
29 
30 `reasoning`, `verdict` are required non-empty strings; `findings`, `nitpicks`, `elevations` are
31 required arrays (may be empty). A malformed draft (missing a required key, a non-object item, an
32 anticipate finding missing its future-state) is **rejected** by the host with a non-zero exit and an
33 honest stderr message — **no partial / forged output is written.**
34 
35 ### `findings[]` — per `kind` (the fields each seam consumes)
36 
37 **`kind: "diagnose"`** — a vetted-core diagnosis. Do NOT add `gandalf_core`; the host stamps it
38 (`stampDiagnoseCoreProvenance`). Do NOT carry any external commission id (diagnosis is the core's).
39 ```jsonc
40 { "id": "d-1", "kind": "diagnose", "rung": "<REFUTED|UNVERIFIED|CLAIMED|CORROBORATED|OBSERVED>",
41   "reasoning": "...", "verdict": "...", "severity": "<minor|major|critical>"? }
42 ```
43 
44 **`kind: "anticipate"`** — a bounded, forward-looking premortem on the SINGLE effort. Emit the two
45 future-state fields; the host composes the finding (`composeAnticipation` sets `subject_cardinality: 1`
46 and refuses any regret / counterfactual-cost field).
47 ```jsonc
48 { "id": "a-1", "kind": "anticipate", "rung": "UNVERIFIED",
49   "reasoning": "...", "verdict": "...",
50   "future_state_condition": "<a not-yet-present condition>",
51   "enabling_assumption":    "<what must hold for it to arrive>",
52   "severity": "<minor|major|critical>"? }
53 ```
54 
55 **`kind: "situate"`** — a best-in-class framing. Emit the SITUATE pipeline stages; the host composes +
56 honesty-caps the finding (`composeSituate`). **Tier-1 has no live researchPrime commission**, so
57 `facts_verified` is `false` by construction and the host attaches the `needs_verification` handoff.
58 ```jsonc
59 { "id": "s-1", "kind": "situate", "reasoning": "...", "verdict": "...",
60   "abstraction":  { "stage": "S0-abstract", "skeleton": "<domain-neutral pattern>" },
61   "commission":   { "skill": "researchPrime", "question": "...", "cross_model": false,
62                     "origin_family": "fable-5", "independent_origin": false,
63                     "researchprime_commission_id": null },
64   "structure_map": { "answer": "<answer-first conclusion>",
65                      "correspondences": [
66                        { "source_relation": "...", "target_relation": "..." },
67                        { "source_relation": "...", "target_relation": "..." }  /* >= 2, RELATIONAL */
68                      ] },
69   "outside_view_base_rate": "<the outside-view base rate>" }
70 ```
71 
72 A finding of any other `kind` (or none) passes through untouched. A finding with `rung: "REFUTED"`
73 **drops** (the only drop condition).
74 
75 ### `elevations[]` — forward suggestions (NO tier, NO stamp)
76 
77 Emit the suggestion + the **named concrete defeater** (`what_would_refute_it`), never a tier or a
78 stamp. In Tier-1 no independent refuter runs, so the host downgrades **every** elevation to
79 `SPECULATIVE` and stamps it `"no independent refutation ran"` (`vetElevationRefutation` + `labelTier`).
80 ```jsonc
81 { "id": "e-1", "value_if_true": "<low|medium|high>", "rung": "<...>",
82   "reasoning": "...", "verdict": "...",
83   "what_would_refute_it": "<a NAMED concrete defeater — never a confidence word>",
84   "severity": "<minor|major|critical>"? }
85 ```
86 A `rung: "REFUTED"` elevation **drops**.
87 
88 ## What the host applies (deterministically, never the model)
89 
90 | Stage | Seam | Effect |
91 |-------|------|--------|
92 | diagnose | `seam/diagnose-core.stampDiagnoseCoreProvenance` | appends `gandalf_core: { protocol: "PROTOCOL v2" }` |
93 | anticipate | `seam/anticipate.composeAnticipation` | `subject_cardinality: 1`; B3 + B9 enforced |
94 | situate | `seam/situate.composeSituate` | rung cap (no self-CORROBORATED) + `needs_verification` handoff |
95 | elevation | `seam/refute.vetElevationRefutation` → `seam/score-label.labelTier` | SPECULATIVE floor + stamp; single-family PROMISING ceiling |
96 | drop | `seam/score-label.dropsFromOutput` | only `rung: "REFUTED"` drops |
97 | synthesis | `seam/score-label.composeRiskLabels` | one `risk_labels` entry per present leg, envelope rung, PROMISING ceiling |
98 | degradation | (host roll-up) | any per-item `degraded: true` ⇒ top-level `degraded: true` (B6) |
99 
100 The result is validated by the shipped `test/harness.assertIncrement1Conformant` before it is written;
101 if it would not pass, the host exits non-zero and writes nothing.
102 
103 ## Scope note (Tier-1)
104 
105 This host runs the **deterministic** seam pass on ONE model run. It does **not** dispatch the live
106 independent named-defeater refuters or the researchPrime SITUATE commission (those need the `agent()`
107 seam the repo flags as the integration point the gate never runs). The **live-refuter PROMISING tier**
108 is the sequenced follow-on — see `LESSONS.md` and `journal/`.
